description: Read or change any preference object of the application or the active document by name, such as textPreferences, guidePreferences or pasteboardPreferences: every preferences pane and default setting is one. get lists its properties; set changes properties given as booleans, numbers, strings, lists or { enum: "Enum.MEMBER" }. Lengths are millimetres (Application/Document preference objects)

action.description: Read the properties, or set some

preference.description: The preference object's property name, such as "textPreferences", "viewPreferences" or "storyPreferences"

target.description: The application's preferences (defaults for new documents) or the active document's

values.description: For set: property name to value, e.g. { "typographersQuotes": true, "smallCap": 70, "baselineGridColor": { "enum": "UIColors.LIGHT_BLUE" } }

name: edit_preference_object
title: Edit Preference Object
